title: Rio (2011 film)
blurb: A streetwise red-crested cardinal and samba enthusiast, one of Blu and Jewel's bird friends in Rio de Janeiro.
facts: Produced by 20th Century Fox Animation and Blue Sky Studios, the film features the voices of Anne Hathaway, Jesse Eisenberg, Jemaine Clement, Leslie Mann, George Lopez, and Jamie...
It follows Blu (Eisenberg), a domesticated male Spix's macaw, who is taken back to Rio de Janeiro to mate with Jewel (Hathaway), a free-spirited female macaw.
They fall in love whilst escaping from bird smugglers and Nigel (Clement), a cockatoo.
studio: Blue Sky Studios / 20th Century Fox Animation
